full_prompt_en: A square architectural illustration shows a traditional wooden hall with layered sweeping roofs against a warm cream paper ground. The upper background is largely empty, carrying faint construction lines, scattered marks, and a small soft tree shape behind the main roof rather than a fully rendered landscape. A wide blue-green tiled roof stretches from the left edge up to a high central ridge and curls outward at the right tip. Beneath the deep eaves, red-brown beams and small brackets form a close rhythm of dark and golden recesses. At the front left, a lower roof shelters an open raised gallery with slim posts, horizontal railings, and shadowed space below. The main room occupies the middle and right, with warm reddish timber panels, a narrow dark doorway, and a second roofline visible behind it. Steps rise from the pale ground to the entrance at the lower right, while the whole structure rests on a substantial blue-gray stone platform. Loose pencil-like verticals and horizontals remain visible through the image, especially around the roof silhouette and across the foreground, as if a measured sketch has been built up with translucent color. Short dark strokes define tiles, beam ends, joints, and platform edges, while washed color softens the wall faces and paper. The view is low enough to show the underside of the projecting roofs and slightly oblique so the left gallery extends toward the viewer. Mild daylight from the upper left catches the roof ridges and warm wood, while the eaves cast broad cool shadows over the openings and under the gallery. Small marks near the right margin resemble writing but cannot be read with confidence. The composition balances a dense diagonal stack of curved roofs and fine structural lines with open, aged paper space, producing a quiet study of timber, tile, and shadow.
full_prompt_zh: 这幅方形建筑插画把一座层叠翘檐的传统木构殿堂置于暖奶油色纸面上。上方背景大部分留空，只有隐约的构图线、零散痕迹与主屋顶后方一团柔和树影，并未画成完整风景。一片宽阔的蓝绿色瓦顶从左边伸向较高的中央屋脊，在右端向外翘起。深檐下，红棕色梁架与细小斗拱形成紧密的深色和金色凹处节奏。前方左侧，较低屋顶遮着一座抬高的开放廊台，细柱、水平栏杆及下方的阴影空间都能看见。主屋位于中间与右侧，有暖红色木板墙、狭窄的暗门，后面还露出另一道屋顶线。台阶从浅色地面升到右下方入口，整座建筑坐落在厚实的蓝灰石台基上。松散的铅笔式竖线和横线仍透过画面可见，尤其在屋顶外轮廓附近和前景中，仿佛一幅测绘写生逐层覆上透明颜色。短促深线定义瓦片、梁端、榫接和台基边缘，淡淡的色洗则柔化墙面与纸张。视点略低，能看到伸出屋檐的底面，并稍有斜角，使左侧廊台朝观者延伸。温和日光从左上方照亮屋脊和暖色木材，檐口则把大片冷影投到开口和廊台下。右边缘有些像文字的小痕迹，但无法有把握地辨读。构图以密集斜向叠合的曲线屋顶和细结构线，对照开阔古旧的纸面空间，形成木、瓦和阴影的宁静写生。
style_prompt_en: A hand-drawn architectural study layers translucent muted color over visible measured linework. Blue-green and cool gray washes define upper planes and bases, while russet, amber, and dark brown strokes give projecting forms warmth and structural depth. Edges alternate between ruled construction lines, quick broken pencil marks, and more confident ink-dark accents at joints and recesses. Large cream paper areas remain exposed, with stains and faint ghost lines making the support part of the image. Gentle daylight lifts outward surfaces; broad, cool shadows collect beneath overlaps instead of creating hard dramatic contrast. The massing moves diagonally upward through several sweeping tiers, while open margin space keeps the intricate center breathable. The effect is historical, tactile, and carefully observed without losing the looseness of a sketch.
style_prompt_zh: 手绘建筑写生把透明的低饱和颜色层叠在仍可见的测绘线条上。蓝绿和冷灰色洗定义上表面与基部，赤褐、琥珀色和深棕笔线赋予突出的形体暖意及结构深度。边缘在尺规式构图线、迅疾断续的铅笔痕迹与关节和凹处更肯定的墨黑强调之间交替。大片奶油色纸面暴露着，污痕和隐约的底稿线使载体本身参与成像。温和日光提亮朝外的表面；宽阔冷影聚在层叠形体下方，没有形成生硬戏剧性反差。体量经数层舒展曲线斜向上升，而开放的边缘留白使繁密中央仍可呼吸。效果古雅、可触而观察细致，同时保留写生的松动感。
theme_en: A traditional wooden hall with sweeping tiled roofs in a weathered architectural sketch
theme_zh: 风化建筑写生中的翘檐木构殿堂
name: Traditional Japanese architecture
reuse_rule: Use style_prompt_en/zh for transferable visual style. Full prompts and themes are examples of the original scene, not content to carry into a new user theme.
